scope: Manual visual review of the five same-class cross-split pairs among the dHash top 50; not an exhaustive near-duplicate search
interpretation: All pairs follow the official CUB-200-2011 train/test metadata. None has identical file SHA-256. Visual duplication in the source benchmark is distinct from cache or model-update leakage.

reviewed_pairs.note: Same scene and framing; visual content effectively identical, despite different bytes.
Same bird, branch, and framing; visual content effectively identical, despite different bytes.
Same bird and perch with altered framing/watermark; possible image variant.
Very similar bird and scene but beak/pose differs; may be distinct burst frames.
Same setting with slight bird-position difference; may be distinct burst frames.

different_class_false_positive_example.note: Visually different birds/scenes; low dHash distance alone is insufficient.

caveat: The five-image bound applies only to reviewed candidates; dHash top-50 is not an exhaustive bound on all possible perceptual duplicates.
